name: pythia
description: One local API call gives your agent the entire live state of the planet — every major world event at once, plus forecasts. 30+ free keyless feeds, runs entirely on Ollama. No cloud, no cost.  Keyless live feeds into one global view and forecasts what’s likely next. No cloud, no keys, no cost.  1d,1w,1m,1y predictions by Mirofish.
